description: Shared validation vectors for email-content.v1 (contract: docs/email-marketing/EMAIL_CONTENT_V1_CONTRACT.md). The SQL validator must accept every 'valid' case with exactly the listed merge_tags and content_sha256, and reject every 'invalid' case with exactly the listed detail. Cases carry either 'content' (a JSON value) or 'content_json' (raw JSON text, used when the textual JSON form matters). parity 'exact': a conforming TS implementation must reach the same verdict; parity 'db_only': the verdict depends on the PostgreSQL jsonb textual form, which a JS runtime cannot observe after JSON.parse, so PostgreSQL is authoritative. content_sha256 is computed only by PostgreSQL.
